boundary: Frozen display projections of four registered first-nine-hour solver captures. No raw prompts, tool arguments, trajectories, scoring internals or billing data. Descriptive observations, not live execution, matched-study qualification or causal benefit.

packs.title: Codec · context-on · 前 9 小时控制开销

scope.window: First 9 hours from solver start, native receipt time [start,end), all captured responses.

selection.rule: 该运行前九小时的全部请求

limitations: Observed counters only, including any unfinished final Turn; unpersisted requests and later usage remain unknown. No termination or complete cost is inferred.
Donor/prefix study costs and evaluator costs are not included.
Input includes cached input. Output includes any reasoning tokens. No dollar or generation-time estimate.
Elapsed time includes tools and orchestration; it does not measure CPU time or avoidable overhead.
Registered operator binding identifies the case; this does not independently prove run provenance.
